headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment Certification on Listed Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited certified timely payment of interest on Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (SRNCDs) issued via public issue and listed on NSE. The certification was filed under Regulation 57 of SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited submitted a formal intimation to NSE under Regulation 57 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, certifying timely interest payment on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures that were offered through public issue and listed on the exchange. This filing is a standard regulatory requirement for listed debt instruments, confirming the company's compliance with debt servicing obligations and absence of payment defaults. The certification demonstrates the company's debt management discipline and financial standing to investors and creditors.
